title: 'Lucky country has become the hungry country': Foodbank Australia
paragraphs: A 2026 report from Foodbank has revealed that nearly seven in ten food insecure households experienced food insecurity for the first time within the last year.
The report also found that 100,000 more Australian households have experienced food insecurity in the last 12 months.
Foodbank Australia chief executive Kylea Tink said the country needed political and social will to put an end to hunger.
